text: Hino aditii ndee Alqur'aanaare, Deftere Tawreeta jippinaande nden e Annabi Muusaa (yo o his), ɗowornde e goonga, e yurmeende wonannde kala gomɗinɗo nde o jokki nde e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen. Ndee Alqur'aanaare jippinaande e Muhammadu (jom kisiyee) kan, ko Deftere goonginirnde ɗeya Defte adinooɗe nde, e ɗemngal aarabu, fii yo jertinir nde, tooñirɓe ko'e mun ɓen sirkugol yedda Allah, e wewlinirgol nde moƴƴimɓe hakkunde mun e taguɗo ɓe On e hakkunde maɓɓe e tagu Makko ngun.
